summaryZh: Gentner 实验室研究声学通信和真实世界声音的感觉、知觉与认知处理机制，以欧洲椋鸟歌唱系统为主要模型，也研究人类自然语言。团队结合行为实验、清醒鸣禽电生理，以及 MEG、sEEG 和计算模型，研究声音表征与发声相关神经动态。
researchQuestions: 歌声的谱与时间统计信息如何约束和偏置声学模式感知、注意与记忆？
神经元群体如何编码并安排发声序列的时间，其动态如何映射到行为？
脑区之间的协调相互作用如何塑造鸟鸣产生？

evidence.quote: Research in the lab takes an integrative, systems-level approach to understanding the neural mechanisms that govern the sensory, perceptual, and cognitive processing of acoustic communication signals and real-world sounds.
The lab has developed a novel procedure for assaying female song preference that permits extracellular electrophysiology in awake behaving songbirds.
We use state-of-the-art techniques such as MEG and sEEG
Using chronic electrophysiology in freely singing birds alongside state-space models and biomechanical descriptions of vocal production
We want to know how such information constrains and biases acoustic pattern perception, attention, and memory mechanisms.

Using chronic electrophysiology in freely singing birds alongside state-space models and biomechanical descriptions of vocal production, we ask how neural populations encode and time vocal sequences, how their dynamics map onto behavior, and how coordinated interactions between regions shape song production.
